# ntfsmnt

> Mount NTFS volumes read-write on macOS via FUSE-T and ntfs-3g. A stdlib-only
> Python CLI with a local web dashboard, a menu-bar app, and read-only AI
> surfaces. MIT, macOS only, Python ≥ 3.12.

The authoritative docs for people and for agents:

- `AGENTS.md` — repo rules, invariants, commands, layout.
- `README.md` — the product: install, commands, safety model, test suite.
- `docs/AGENT.md` — the agentic UI (`/agent`, OpenUI Lang over AG-UI) and the
  read-only MCP server (`ntfsmnt mcp`).
- `docs/specs/` and `docs/plans/` — one spec + plan per feature.
- `pyproject.toml` — package metadata; version lives only in `ntfsmnt/__init__.py`.
- `tests/manual/acceptance.md` — real-hardware acceptance procedure.

Hard boundaries for any consumer, human or AI: no `osascript`, no auto-run
repair tools, no `SIGKILL` on disk processes, failed mounts restore Apple's
read-only mount, and the web layer never bypasses the CLI's guards.
